This file contains important information that AI agents (such as Claude Code) should reference when working on this project.

Go AST Inspector: standalone Go AST extractor/visualizer in browser; single HTML distribution. Technologies: TypeScript, Svelte 5.x, Go WebAssembly, Vite. UI: English only. Packages: go/ast, go/parser, go/token. Use go/parser to convert source code to AST. Svelte Writable Store: `astStore`, `parseErrorStore`, `selectedNodeStore`, `expandedNodesStore`.

Before work, read REQUIREMENTS.md (objectives, FR-001–FR-006, NFR-001–NFR-006, MVP, technology decisions), then DESIGN.md (3-layer architecture: WebAssembly, Application Logic, UI; modules/directories, Svelte components, Vite/TypeScript/Biome/Svelte configuration, data flow, Svelte Store state management). REQUIREMENTS.md > DESIGN.md. Report contradictions to user and request confirmation. If undocumented, ask user. Do not implement based on independent judgment.

Stack: TypeScript 5.x strict mode; Svelte 5.x runes (`$state`, `$derived`, `$effect`); Vite 5.x; Biome 1.x. Explicitly write type definitions. Avoid magic numbers, use constants. Components follow single responsibility principle. Explicitly type props. BEM naming convention recommended. Global styles in `src/styles/global.css`; component-specific styles in `<style>`.

MUST convention: Prohibit redundant comments (no explanation needed for simple operations)
SHOULD convention: Write comments where code intent is hard to convey
MUST convention: Write commit messages in English
MUST convention: Write Pull Request titles and descriptions in English
MUST convention: Add GPG sign to all commits
MUST convention: Add Claude as Co-Author:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
Co-Authored-By: Claude <<REDACTED_EMAIL>>
MUST convention: Run `npm run lint` before committing
MUST convention: Run `npm run type-check` before committing
If either command exits with an error, fix the issues before committing
Lint errors: Run `npm run format` to auto-fix formatting issues
Type errors: Fix type mismatches in the reported files

Build: use Vite's vite-plugin-singlefile; all JS/CSS/WASM binaries are inlined. Check DESIGN.md build configuration, then package.json dependencies and analyze error messages in detail.

References: https://svelte.dev/; https://svelte.dev/docs/svelte/what-are-runes; https://vitejs.dev/; https://biomejs.dev/; https://github.com/golang/go/wiki/WebAssembly
